# desktop-control MCP tools

45 tools. Only `core` is on by default; enable others with `manage_toolsets(action="enable", domains=[...])`.

## core

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `take_screenshot` | `mode='annotated_som'`, `app_filter=None`, `region=None`, `window_id=None`, `clip_to_active_window=False`, `strategy_override=None`, `zoom_factor=1.0`, `include_image=False` | Captures the desktop screen with visual perception and Set-of-Marks. |
| `manage_toolsets` | `action='list_domains'`, `domains=None`, `output_mode=None` | Manages MCP tool domains and out-of-band payload offloading to save AI prompt tokens. |
| `get_accessibility_tree` | `app_name_filter=None`, `max_depth=16`, `filter_interactable=True`, `diff_only=False`, `output_mode=None` | Directly queries OS accessibility bus (AXUIElement on macOS, AT-SPI2 on Linux) for the live semantic UI tree. Provides ground-truth element names, roles, and physical bounding boxes without visual hallucination. |
| `find_element` | `query`, `role=None`, `fuzzy=True`, `strategy=None` | Autonomously searches for a UI element by text, accessible name, or role. Extremely token-efficient: resolves physical (x, y) coordinates with ZERO screenshot tokens. |
| `click` | `mark_id=None`, `x=None`, `y=None`, `query=None`, `button='left'`, `click_count=1`, `verify_delta=True`, `expected_outcome=None` | Clicks on a UI element either by Set-of-Marks ID, text query, or physical (x, y) coordinates. |
| `find_and_click` | `query`, `button='left'`, `click_count=1`, `verify_delta=True` | Autonomous one-shot action: Finds an element by text query and clicks it with verified delta. |
| `scroll` | `direction='down'`, `amount=3`, `verify_delta=True` | Emulates mouse wheel scroll at current cursor location. |
| `type_text` | `text`, `press_enter=False`, `delay_ms=CONFIG.typing_delay_ms`, `verify_delta=True` | Types text into the currently focused desktop element. |
| `press_key` | `key`, `verify_delta=True` | Presses and releases a single key. |
| `hotkey` | `combo`, `verify_delta=True` | Sends a keyboard chord shortcut (e.g. 'ctrl+c', 'alt+tab', 'ctrl+a'). |
| `ask_screen` | `question=''`, `region=None`, `expected_text=None` | Answers a yes/no question about the screen using the local Gemma model, without sending an image back to the client (zero image tokens). |
| `read_screen_text` | `region=None`, `contains=None`, `regex=False`, `output_mode=None` | Reads text on screen with local OCR (Apple Vision on macOS, RapidOCR on Linux/Windows) and returns lines with boxes and click points. No image is returned, so this costs a few hundred text tokens instead of a screenshot. |

## window_mgmt

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capture_window` | `window_id=None`, `title_filter=None`, `mode='annotated_som'` | High-efficiency perception tool that captures strictly the target or active window. Slashes multimodal token consumption by 60-80% compared to capturing a full 4K display. |
| `list_windows` | none | Lists open desktop windows, titles, geometry bounds, and active focus status. |
| `get_active_window` | none | Returns the currently active / focused window metadata. |
| `focus_window` | `window_id` | Brings target window to the foreground and grants it focus. |
| `wait_for_ui_change` | `timeout_seconds=5.0`, `poll_interval_sec=0.2`, `min_delta_ratio=0.005` | Blocks until a visual change occurs on the desktop. |

## developer

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dismiss_obstructions` | `max_attempts=2` | Autonomous defense & modal triage: Detects and classifies blocking modal popups. Safely auto-dismisses benign popups and acknowledges informative completion notices, while halting and returning an escalation payload for workflow-branching or destructive dialogs. |
| `resolve_modal_dialog` | `button_id=None`, `button_label=None` | Resolves an escalated modal dialog by clicking the specified button option. Allows the orchestrator to safely make decisions on branching or destructive modals (0 visual tokens). |
| `manage_cache` | `action='stats'`, `app_key=None`, `query=None` | Manages the Self-Healing Action & Locator Cache. |
| `click_and_type` | `text`, `query=None`, `mark_id=None`, `x=None`, `y=None`, `clear_first=False`, `press_enter=False`, `delay_ms=CONFIG.typing_delay_ms`, `verify_delta=True` | High-level atomic compound action: Focuses an element (by query, mark_id, or x,y), optionally clears existing text (Ctrl+A -> Backspace), types string with natural cadence, and optionally presses Enter. |
| `move_cursor` | `x`, `y` | Moves the mouse pointer to absolute coordinates (x, y) without clicking. |
| `drag_and_drop` | `start_x`, `start_y`, `end_x`, `end_y`, `duration_sec=0.3`, `verify_delta=True` | Smoothly drags mouse pointer from start coordinates to end coordinates. |
| `scroll_until_visible` | `query`, `direction='down'`, `max_scrolls=6`, `scroll_amount=6`, `verify_delta=True` | Autonomous scroll loop: Iteratively scrolls the viewport until the query element is found. |
| `run_terminal_command` | `command`, `timeout_seconds=CONFIG.command_timeout_seconds` | Executes a shell command in the background for hybrid CLI navigation. |
| `execute_trajectory` | `trajectory_spec` | Local Macro & Trajectory Dispatcher: Executes a structured multi-step declarative trajectory locally at native OS speeds, eliminating dozens of intermediate round-trips to multimodal LLMs. |
| `compact_history` | `max_tokens=12000`, `keep_last_n=2` | Compacts the server-side trajectory log into the 8-part state checkpoint. |

## advanced_vision

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `configure_vision` | `setting`, `value` | Dynamically hotswaps runtime settings for grounding, tokens, and safety. |
| `get_vision_diagnostics` | none | Returns diagnostic health check of the Vision MCP server, active display, available perception backends, and current configuration. |
| `choose_option` | `goal`, `options`, `question='Which option best advances the goal?'`, `state=''`, `verb='click'`, `authorized=False`, `shortlist_to=12` | Asks the local Gemma model to pick one of ``options`` and gates the answer by risk (Jev-style typed decision: no text is generated, probabilities come from logprobs). |
| `find_visual_element` | `description`, `region=None` | Finds an element by description where accessibility gives no names (canvases, custom Qt/Tk widgets, EDA toolbars). Tries local OCR for a visible-text match first; otherwise the local detector proposes boxes, local Gemma picks one by number, and the click point comes from the detector box, never from the model. No image is returned. |

## skills

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start_skill_recording` | `journal_path=None` | GUI-to-Script Crystallization: Starts recording physical GUI actions and correlations with application command journal streams (e.g. vivado.jou, novas.cmd). |
| `stop_skill_recording` | none | Stops active skill recording and returns summary of captured action steps. |
| `start_cassette_recording` | `name`, `capture_images=False`, `capture_ocr=True`, `settle_ms=400` | Starts recording a cassette from this live session. After every input action (click, type, key, hotkey, drag, scroll, focus) the server waits settle_ms and saves AX nodes, OCR lines, windows and cursor. stop_cassette_recording writes the cassette, which replays offline with DESKTOP_HAL=replay, `pytest -m replay`, or crystallize_skill(cassette_path=...). |
| `stop_cassette_recording` | none | Stops the cassette recording and writes <cassette_dir>/<name>/index.json (plus frames/*.jpg when images were captured). Returns the path and counts. |
| `crystallize_skill` | `skill_name`, `task_prompt`, `app_target='vivado_2025.1'`, `extracted_entities=None`, `verification_cmd=None`, `description=None`, `cassette_path=None` | Compiles recorded GUI trajectory into a parameterized, deterministic Tcl/CLI skill, lifting entity literals into Jinja2 parameters and saving to dynamic skill registry. |
| `execute_crystallized_skill` | `skill_name`, `arguments=None` | Executes a crystallized parameterized skill with 0 visual tokens by compiling the template and executing deterministically via application CLI/Tcl bridge. |
| `list_crystallized_skills` | none | Lists all registered crystallized skills available for zero-visual-token deterministic execution. |
| `delete_crystallized_skill` | `skill_name` | Deletes a crystallized skill from the registry. |
